title: Which quantum-like constraints survive disorder averaging? Code and derived data
description: Code and derived data for 'Which quantum-like constraints survive disorder averaging? Reciprocity and observability in heterogeneous populations'. Includes the likelihood-ratio region test with per-dataset feasible-mixture witnesses and a standalone checker on the published question-order datasets, the coding-robustness check, implied covariances, a Monte Carlo check of the detectability boundary, summary tables of the dynamical simulations, and scripts that regenerate all figures.
